images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the attached AI-generated fictional portrait for a website mockup that explicitly identifies the author and portrait as fictional. Keep the same man broadly recognizable, about 48 years old with short grey-brown hair; keep a square head-and-shoulders composition suitable for a circular avatar, with his whole head inside the frame. Change the overly polished stock-photo appearance into a believable, unretouched everyday workplace photograph taken by a colleague on a normal phone. He is the facilities coordinator at an art school, wearing an ordinary slightly worn charcoal quarter-zip sweater over a shirt, not a model or executive. Natural asymmetric posture, shoulders slightly turned, head toward the camera, relaxed restrained half smile, real eye bags, expression lines, uneven skin tone, pores, a few stray hairs. Simple realistic art-school utility room in the background: painted pale wall, a wooden shelf and an easel partly visible, moderate depth of field so it looks like a real room rather than a creamy studio blur. Ordinary side window light with mild shadows and imperfect white balance; realistic phone-camera micrograin and restrained sharpness. Avoid beauty retouching, glossy skin, idealized facial symmetry, cinematic lighting, advertising aesthetics, excessive HDR, extreme bokeh, oversaturated colours, caricature or exaggerated blemishes. No other people, text, logos, watermarks or readable signage. The result should look like a casual staff portrait someone actually took during a working day.
